profile.name: Balaji Chaughule
profile.tagline: BCS student and aspiring backend developer building clean web interfaces, practical dashboards, and API-minded projects in public.
profile.summary: I use every project to improve the fundamentals: readable structure, responsive UI, clear data flow, and dependable implementation habits. My current path is frontend delivery today with steady progress toward backend APIs and service logic.

aboutPoints.title: Learning by building
aboutPoints.text: I turn coursework and self-learning into shipped GitHub projects, with attention to layout, interaction details, and maintainable structure.

aboutPoints.title: Backend curiosity
aboutPoints.text: My focus is moving toward Node.js, Express, REST APIs, data modeling, and server-side logic that is simple to reason about.

aboutPoints.title: Public progress
aboutPoints.text: I keep my progress visible through public repositories so each project shows a clearer version of how I think and build.

projects.title: Shree Sai Web App
projects.description: A JavaScript-heavy web app with a structured frontend workspace, PocketBase files, migrations, hooks, and product/category data flow.

projects.title: JSPM College Website
projects.description: A React and Vite college website with component-based sections for courses, gallery, notices, facilities, contact, and page interactions.

projects.title: Tailwind Bundle Files
projects.description: A TypeScript-first Tailwind bundle organized around reusable sections, asset structure, and production-style landing page templates.

projects.title: FoodMart
projects.description: A large food and grocery storefront interface with responsive HTML sections, custom CSS, visual assets, and JavaScript enhancements.

projects.title: School Management System
projects.description: A multi-page school management dashboard with attendance, classes, fees, messages, settings, students, teachers, and timetable screens.

projects.title: BrandX Info
projects.description: A recent brand information website with clean static structure, focused pages, custom styling, and lightweight JavaScript behavior.
